name: iMessage (SSH)
description: Read and search iMessage and SMS history on your Mac over SSH. Enter your Mac’s user@host; OpenTeam manages the internal connection.
installationSteps: Enter your Mac’s SSH destination, such as yourname@100.64.0.10, in account settings.
Choose Connect. OpenTeam verifies SSH and Messages access and prepares the restricted reader automatically using the host’s existing SSH access.
The Mac must be reachable, with Remote Login enabled and Messages history accessible to the SSH user.
This version reads history only. The Mac must stay online; sending and attachment downloads are not supported.

fields.label: Mac SSH destination
fields.helpText: The OpenTeam host must already have passwordless SSH access and a verified host key for this Mac. No gateway address or token is needed.
